mapper.select: select alliance_id as allianceId, alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, source_member_id as sourceMemberId, target_member_id as targetMemberId, alliance_order_status as allianceOrderStatus from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and alliance_order_id = #{allianceOrderId} and (source_member_id = #{memberId} or target_member_id = #{memberId}) and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute (tenant_id, alliance_order_id, initiator_member_id, respondent_member_id, dispute_type, dispute_status, claim_amount, description, idempotency_key, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, mediation_deadline, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{allianceOrderId}, #{initiatorMemberId}, #{respondentMemberId}, #{disputeType}, 0, #{claimAmount}, #{description}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), date_add(now(), interval 90 day), 0)
mapper.select: select dispute_id as disputeId, dispute_status as disputeStatus from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select d.dispute_id as disputeId, d.alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, d.initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.claim_amount as claimAmount, d.awarded_amount as awardedAmount, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount, d.description, d.resolution, d.mediation_deadline as mediationDeadline, d.create_time as createTime, d.update_time as updateTime, o.order_no as orderNo from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = a.source_order_id and o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and o.member_id = a.source_member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (d.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} or d.respondent_member_id = #{memberId}) and d.is_delete = 0 and d.dispute_status = #{disputeStatus} order by d.create_time desc, d.dispute_id desc

select d.dispute_id as disputeId, d.alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, a.alliance_id as allianceId, o.order_no as orderNo, d.initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.claim_amount as claimAmount, d.awarded_amount as awardedAmount, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount, d.description, d.resolution, d.mediation_deadline as mediationDeadline, d.create_time as createTime, d.update_time as updateTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order o on o.order_id = a.source_order_id and o.tenant_id = a.tenant_id and o.member_id = a.source_member_id and o.is_delete = 0 where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.dispute_id = #{disputeId} and (d.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} or d.respondent_member_id = #{memberId}) and d.is_delete = 0

select d.dispute_id as disputeId, d.alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, a.alliance_id as allianceId, d.initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.claim_amount as claimAmount, d.awarded_amount as awardedAmount, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount, d.description, d.resolution, d.mediation_deadline as mediationDeadline from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 where d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and d.dispute_id = #{disputeId} and d.is_delete = 0 for update

select d.tenant_id as tenantId, d.dispute_id as disputeId, d.alliance_order_id as allianceOrderId, a.alliance_id as allianceId, d.initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.claim_amount as claimAmount, d.awarded_amount as awardedAmount, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount, d.description, d.resolution, d.mediation_deadline as mediationDeadline from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 where d.dispute_id = #{disputeId} and d.is_delete = 0 for update
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute_evidence (tenant_id, dispute_id, member_id, evidence_type, file_url, file_name, content, evidence_status, create_by, create_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{disputeId}, #{memberId}, #{evidenceType}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileName}, #{content}, 1, #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.select: select evidence_id as evidenceId, member_id as memberId, evidence_type as evidenceType, file_url as fileUrl, file_name as fileName, content, evidence_status as evidenceStatus, create_time as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute_evidence where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time asc, evidence_id asc

select mediation_id as mediationId, round_no as roundNo, mediator_user_id as mediatorUserId, proposal_amount as proposalAmount, proposal_content as proposalContent, mediation_status as mediationStatus, initiator_confirmed as initiatorConfirmed, respondent_confirmed as respondentConfirmed, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0 and mediation_id = ( select latest.mediation_id from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation latest where latest.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and latest.dispute_id = #{disputeId} and latest.is_delete = 0 order by latest.round_no desc, latest.mediation_id desc limit 1 ) for update

select mediation_id as mediationId, round_no as roundNo, mediator_user_id as mediatorUserId, proposal_amount as proposalAmount, proposal_content as proposalContent, mediation_status as mediationStatus, initiator_confirmed as initiatorConfirmed, respondent_confirmed as respondentConfirmed, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0 order by round_no desc, mediation_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation (tenant_id, dispute_id, round_no, mediator_user_id, proposal_amount, proposal_content, mediation_status, initiator_confirmed, respondent_confirmed, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{disputeId}, #{roundNo}, #{mediatorUserId}, #{proposalAmount}, #{proposalContent}, 1, 0, 0, #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), 0)
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute set dispute_status = #{toStatus}, resolution = #{resolution}, awarded_amount = #{awardedAmount}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and dispute_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation m set
initiator_confirmed = 1, initiator_confirmed_time = now(),
respondent_confirmed = 1, respondent_confirmed_time = now(),
update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and mediation_status = #{mediationStatus} and is_delete = 0 and initiator_confirmed = 0respondent_confirmed = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation set mediation_status = if(#{memberRole} = 'initiator', 3, 4), update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and mediation_status = #{mediationStatus} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_mediation set mediation_status = 2, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and mediation_status = #{mediationStatus} and initiator_confirmed = 1 and respondent_confirmed = 1 and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute set frozen_amount = #{frozenAmount}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and is_delete = 0

update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute set dispute_status = 5, resolution = #{resolution}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and dispute_status = 0 and is_delete = 0
mapper.select: select d.tenant_id as tenantId, d.dispute_id as disputeId, a.alliance_id as allianceId, d.respondent_member_id as respondentMemberId, d.frozen_amount as frozenAmount from ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute d left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance a on a.alliance_order_id = d.alliance_order_id and a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id and a.is_delete = 0 where d.mediation_deadline is not null and d.mediation_deadline <= now() and d.dispute_status in (0, 1, 2, 3) and d.is_delete = 0 order by d.mediation_deadline asc, d.dispute_id asc limit 500
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_order_alliance_dispute set dispute_status = 6, resolution = #{resolution}, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = now() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and dispute_id = #{disputeId} and mediation_deadline is not null and mediation_deadline <= now() and dispute_status in (0, 1, 2, 3) and is_delete = 0
